  • Budtender

    Full-Time / Part-Time

    Be the face of the dispensary. Guide customers through our menu, recommend products that fit their needs, and create a welcoming, judgment-free experience.

    Apply Now

    Full-Time / Part-Time

    Budtender

    What you’ll do

    • Greet and educate customers on cannabis products, dosing, and effects
    • Process orders accurately on POS and Dutchie
    • Maintain a clean, organized sales floor and display cases
    • Verify IDs and follow all NJ-CRC compliance rules

    What we’re looking for

    • Must be 21+ with a valid government-issued ID
    • Cannabis product knowledge (or strong desire to learn)
    • Excellent customer service and communication skills
    • Reliable transportation and weekend availability
    Apply Now

  • Lead Budtender

    Full-Time

    Set the standard on the floor. Mentor new budtenders, own product knowledge training, and help shift leads keep the customer experience tight.

    Apply Now

    Full-Time

    Lead Budtender

    What you’ll do

    • Train and coach new budtenders on product and process
    • Run cash drawer reconciliation and end-of-day reports
    • Be the go-to expert for complex customer questions
    • Support the Shift Lead with floor coverage and breaks

    What we’re looking for

    • 6+ months budtender experience (or equivalent retail leadership)
    • Deep cannabis product knowledge
    • Comfortable training and giving feedback to peers
    • Open availability including evenings and weekends
    Apply Now

  • Inventory Specialist

    Full-Time

    Own the back-of-house. Receive deliveries, audit manifests, manage expirations, and keep our Dutchie menu perfectly in sync with what is actually on the shelf.

    Apply Now

    Full-Time

    Inventory Specialist

    What you’ll do

    • Receive vendor deliveries and verify against manifests
    • Track expiration dates and rotate stock (FIFO)
    • Maintain accurate counts in Dutchie + internal inventory tools
    • Flag discrepancies and coordinate with management on returns

    What we’re looking for

    • Prior inventory, receiving, or warehouse experience
    • Strong attention to detail and comfort with spreadsheets
    • Ability to lift up to 40 lbs
    • Basic familiarity with cannabis product categories is a plus
    Apply Now

  • Delivery Driver

    Part-Time / Full-Time

    Bring premium cannabis right to the customer’s door. Run safe, on-time deliveries throughout our service area while representing the brand with professionalism.

    Apply Now

    Part-Time / Full-Time

    Delivery Driver

    What you’ll do

    • Run scheduled delivery routes in a company or personal vehicle
    • Verify customer ID and Dutchie Pay payment at the door
    • Maintain a clean driving log and follow all CRC delivery rules
    • Communicate ETAs and handle customer questions in transit

    What we’re looking for

    • Valid NJ driver’s license with a clean driving record (3+ years)
    • Reliable, insured vehicle (mileage reimbursed)
    • Smartphone proficiency for routing and order apps
    • Must pass background check
    Apply Now

  • Security

    Full-Time / Part-Time

    Keep our team and customers safe. Monitor entry, verify IDs, and maintain a calm, welcoming presence at the front of the store.

    Apply Now

    Full-Time / Part-Time

    Security

    What you’ll do

    • Verify all customer IDs at entry (21+)
    • Monitor sales floor and parking lot via cameras and walkthroughs
    • De-escalate situations calmly and professionally
    • Coordinate with local law enforcement when necessary

    What we’re looking for

    • NJ SORA certification preferred (or willingness to obtain)
    • Prior security, military, or law enforcement experience a plus
    • Calm under pressure with strong verbal communication
    • Ability to stand for long shifts
    Apply Now

  • Shift Lead

    Full-Time

    Run the floor. You’re the on-shift point person for budtenders, customer escalations, opening/closing procedures, and daily compliance.

    Apply Now

    Full-Time

    Shift Lead

    What you’ll do

    • Open and close the store following SOPs and compliance checklists
    • Coach and direct budtenders during the shift
    • Resolve customer escalations and process refunds/exchanges
    • Monitor floor coverage, break rotations, and queue times

    What we’re looking for

    • 1+ year retail leadership experience (cannabis preferred)
    • Strong working knowledge of NJ-CRC compliance
    • Comfortable with POS, scheduling tools, and Dutchie back-office
    • Open availability including weekends and evenings
